name: 通用表格识别（青果 / 苏亚 / 其他）
author: CourseTable 内置
hint: 适用于以 HTML 表格展示、表头含“星期一/周一”、首列为节次、单元格内含“x-y周”字样的课表页面（青果 KINGOSOFT、苏亚、URP 等多数系统）。
script: function dayOf(t){ t=(t||'').replace(/\s/g,''); const map={'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4,'五':5,'六':6,'日':7,'天':7}; const m=t.match(/(星期|周|礼拜)([一二三四五六日天])/); if(m) return map[m[2]]; const en=t.toLowerCase().match(/mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun/); if(en) return ['mon','tue','wed','thu','fri','sat','sun'].indexOf(en[0])+1; return 0; } const tables=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table')); let best=null, bestScore=0; for(const tb of tables){ const rows=Array.from(tb.rows); let dayCols={}; let headRow=-1; for(let r=0;r<Math.min(rows.length,4);r++){ const cells=Array.from(rows[r].cells); const dc={}; cells.forEach(function(c,i){ const d=dayOf(c.innerText); if(d) dc[i]=d; }); if(Object.keys(dc).length>=5){ dayCols=dc; headRow=r; break; } } if(headRow<0) continue; const score=Object.keys(dayCols).length*100+rows.length; if(score>bestScore){ bestScore=score; best={tb:tb,rows:rows,dayCols:dayCols,headRow:headRow}; } } if(!best) throw '页面中没有找到包含“星期一…星期日”表头的课表表格，请先打开课表页面'; const out=[]; const occupied={}; const dayIdx=Object.keys(best.dayCols).map(Number); let period=0; for(let r=best.headRow+1;r<best.rows.length;r++){ const tr=best.rows[r]; const cells=Array.from(tr.cells); if(!cells.length) continue; const first=cells[0].innerText||''; const pm=first.match(/(\d{1,2})\D{0,3}(\d{1,2})?/); let sp, ep; if(pm && /节|第|小节|^\s*\d/.test(first)){ sp=parseInt(pm[1]); ep=pm[2]?parseInt(pm[2]):sp; period=ep; } else { period++; sp=ep=period; } let col=0; let ci=0; const total=dayIdx.length? Math.max.apply(null,dayIdx)+1 : cells.length; for(let c=0;c<total && ci<cells.length;c++){ if(occupied[r+','+c]) { continue; } const cell=cells[ci++]; const rs=cell.rowSpan||1; for(let k=1;k<rs;k++) occupied[(r+k)+','+c]=true; const day=best.dayCols[c]; if(!day) continue; const txt=(cell.innerText||'').trim(); if(!txt) continue; const rowsSpan=rs; const segs=txt.split(/\n{2,}|-{3,}/); for(const seg of segs){ const lines=seg.split('\n').map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(Boolean); if(!lines.length) continue; let name=lines[0]; let weekText='', loc='', teacher=''; for(const l of lines.slice(1)){ if(/周/.test(l) && /\d/.test(l)) { weekText = weekText? weekText+','+l : l; } else if(/楼|室|教|馆|厅|场|中心|[A-Za-z]\d|\d{3,}/.test(l) && !loc) loc=l; else if(!teacher && l.length<=12) teacher=l; } const jm=weekText.match(/(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)\s*节/) || weekText.match(/\[(\d+)-(\d+)/); const s2 = jm?parseInt(jm[1]):sp; const e2 = jm?parseInt(jm[2]):(rowsSpan>1? sp+rowsSpan-1 : ep); out.push({name:name, teacher:teacher, location:loc, day:day, startPeriod:s2, endPeriod:e2, weekText: weekText.replace(/\[.*?\]/g,'')}); } } } if(!out.length) throw '找到了表格但没有解析到课程单元格'; return {courses: out};
